title: WPA Citation, Reference & Source Traceability Policy
default_style: APA 7 where bibliographic style is required; exact source locators always take priority over cosmetic formatting.
purpose: Every material fact, core-essence extraction, Practice Atom, Scholarly Knowledge Atom, analytical brief and publication-ready output must retain a verifiable path back to its source.
non_negotiables: Never invent an author, title, year/date, publisher, edition, DOI, ISBN, ISSN, URL, page number, section or quotation.
If essential metadata cannot be verified, use REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED rather than completing fields from inference.
Prefer the original/primary source. Secondary reporting must be cited as secondary reporting.
Institutional statements and press releases document what the issuer states; they are not independent corroboration.
Every derived WPA knowledge object must preserve source_id, source URL/identifier, retrieval date, access basis, citation status and correction status.
For PDFs/books/papers, page or section locators are required for material evidence whenever technically available.
A publicly accessible PDF is not automatically an open licence. Accessibility, processing permission and redistribution permission are separate fields.
WPA publishes its own synthesis. Substantial third-party expression is not republished unless an applicable licence/permission explicitly allows it.

PUBLIC_WEB_REFERENCE.processing: Source-bounded reading and factual/practice extraction from public HTML.
PUBLIC_WEB_REFERENCE.storage: Metadata, provenance and derived WPA notes only.
PUBLIC_WEB_REFERENCE.redistribution: No mirroring of substantial third-party text.

PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_ANALYSIS_ONLY.processing: Temporary full-document analysis of a deliberately allowlisted public PDF/document.
PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_ANALYSIS_ONLY.storage: No third-party full text in the public repository; retain hash, metadata, locators and derived notes.
PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_ANALYSIS_ONLY.redistribution: No full-text republication; only appropriately attributed synthesis and limited quotation.
PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_ANALYSIS_ONLY.caveat: Public accessibility is not treated as an open licence.

OPEN_ACCESS.processing: Full-document analysis where open-access status is explicitly established.
OPEN_ACCESS.storage: Derived knowledge and provenance; full-text storage only if licence and storage policy permit.
OPEN_ACCESS.redistribution: According to the applicable licence/rights statement.

OPEN_LICENSE.storage: According to licence and WPA storage policy.

PUBLIC_DOMAIN.storage: Permitted subject to WPA governance and provenance.
PUBLIC_DOMAIN.redistribution: Permitted subject to provenance and any non-copyright restrictions.

AGREEMENT_ON_FILE.processing: Only within the recorded agreement scope.
AGREEMENT_ON_FILE.storage: Only within the recorded agreement scope.

MANUALLY_AUTHORISED.processing: Only within the recorded permission scope.
MANUALLY_AUTHORISED.storage: Only within the recorded permission scope.

locator_policy.pdf_book_paper: Exact page required for material evidence when PDF text extraction preserves pagination.
locator_policy.html: Use heading/section/anchor when available; otherwise record LOCATOR_NOT_AVAILABLE_AUTOMATICALLY.
locator_policy.dataset: Use record ID, field and version.

publication_gate: A material claim based on an external source may not be treated as publication-ready if its citation_status is REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or WITHHELD.
correction_rule: If a source, metadata record or locator is corrected, downstream WPA objects using that reference enter RECHECK_REQUIRED until reviewed.
